prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize carbohydrate timing and intake for a 20km long run training session scheduled for 10:00 AM

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day (breakfast, pre-workout, post-workout, and other meals) with appropriate timing around the 20km run
Carbohydrate-rich meals are strategically timed: 2-3 hours before run and within 30-60 minutes after run
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and gluten-free
Plan is compact and concise (fits on a single reference page or brief format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a elite endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around long training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass with caloric surplus for strength training

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with high protein at each meal (minimum 30g per meal)
Total daily calories create a moderate surplus appropriate for muscle building (approximately 500+ kcal above maintenance for 90kg athlete)
Plan prioritizes whole foods suitable for a strength athlete with minimal cardio focus
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein distribution and caloric surplus for muscle building with minimal cardio

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for soccer training with morning session (10 AM) and evening match (7 PM)

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions with appropriate timing around both training sessions
Macronutrient distribution supports soccer performance (adequate carbohydrates, protein, and healthy fats)
Hydration strategy specified for pre/during/post training and match
All meals comply with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (soccer player) requiring balanced macronutrients, hydration strategy, and meal timing around both morning and evening training sessions
